source_text: The aim of the reaction is test/optimization:  5-fluoro-4-(2-methyl-1-(tetrahydro-2H-pyran-4-yl)-1H-imidazol-5-yl)pyrimidin-2-amine (100 mg, 0.36 mmol), 4-(4-bromo-3-fluorobenzyl)morpholine (109 mg, 0.40 mmol), Palladium, 10% On Charcoal (115 mg, 0.11 mmol), (R)-(-)-1-[(S)-2-(Dicyclohexylphosphino)ferrocenyl]ethyldi-t-butylphosphine (91 mg, 0.16 mmol) and Sodium tert-pentoxide (79 mg, 0.72 mmol) were dissolved in toluene (1.5 mL) and heated to 110 °C under argon.  The reaction was monitorred by HPLC. After 16 h 79 % conversion was achieved. The reaction was stopped and the mixture was discarded.
representation_scope: supplied_text_operations; source experimental completeness is not independently certified

sampling_schedule.evidence: The reaction was monitorred by HPLC.

meta.evidence: The reaction was monitorred by HPLC.

unresolved: The order of individual reagent additions is not specified; the listed order is retained.
"After 16 h 79 % conversion was achieved." establishes a 16-hour reaction interval, represented as Wait; it does not explicitly establish that 110 °C was maintained throughout.
The method used to stop the reaction and the destination or method of disposal are not specified.
uncertainties: The source does not report a dissolution technique or stirring.
Argon is reported as the reaction environment; its establishment method is not reported.
The 16 h is reported as elapsed reaction time, not as a separately specified heating duration.
HPLC sampling times, sampling procedures, and analytical settings are not reported.
The reaction-stopping method and mixture-disposal method are not reported.

DiscardMixture.name: DiscardMixture
DiscardMixture.description: Discard the specified mixture as waste without inferring a waste destination, transfer apparatus, or treatment method.
effects: Removes the specified mixture from further experimental processing as discarded material.

DissolveMaterials.name: DissolveMaterials
DissolveMaterials.description: Perform the reported dissolution of charged materials in the specified solvent. Does not imply stirring, complete dissolution of every component, or an unreported dissolution technique.
effects: Subjects the charged materials to the reported dissolution operation.

MonitorReaction.name: MonitorReaction
MonitorReaction.description: Monitor the reaction using the reported analytical method, without inferring sampling times, sampling procedures, or analytical settings.
effects: Obtains analytical observations of reaction progress; does not itself constitute a synthetic transformation.

RecordConversionObservation.name: RecordConversionObservation
RecordConversionObservation.description: Record the reported conversion at the stated elapsed reaction time. This is an observation, not an instruction to achieve a conversion or an additional waiting operation.
effects: Records the source-reported conversion observation without changing vessel contents.

StopReaction.name: StopReaction
StopReaction.description: Terminate the ongoing reaction operation by the reported method. An unspecified method does not imply quenching, cooling, neutralization, or cessation of heating.
effects: Marks the reported termination of the reaction operation without asserting a chemical quench.
